# Hikasha Chat v0.1.5

The Windows overlay polish release, with a cleaner header, glass notifications,
an in-app download shortcut, and the full standalone Android client source.

## Highlights

- **Clean, always-visible header**
  - Removed the connection status dot and all header status text.
  - The logo/title, Twitch/YouTube/Kick viewer pills, and all control icons
    remain visible at every allowed size.
  - The icon group is centered; widening the panel adds equal space on both
    sides.
  - The panel wraps tightly at its 380px minimum, with no fixed right-side gap.
- **In-panel notifications**
  - Errors, update notices, URL-save confirmations, Reload feedback, and
    mouse-pass-through changes appear as dismissible toasts.
  - Transparent mode uses a translucent glass surface; opaque mode uses the
    cream card style.
- **Download button**
  - New header download icon opens the latest GitHub release page in the
    default browser.
- **Streaming quality of life**
  - Mouse pass-through with the OS-global `Ctrl+Win+I` shortcut and tray
    fallback.
  - In-app Reload restarts the viewer poller and widget together.
  - Tray Show/Hide preserves the chat session and pauses polling while hidden.
  - Viewer-count hydration avoids blank/dimmed pills after load or reload.
  - Keyboard-focus handling keeps gameplay input with the game while
    pass-through is active.
- **Android companion source**
  - Standalone Capacitor 8 app in `mobile/` with setup/tutorial/chat screens,
    local link storage, strict BotRix URL validation, release signing, and no
    desktop-only overlay/pin/tray/pass-through features.
- **Release and security**
  - Electron 44.11.6 and current toolchain.
  - URL-safe Windows artifact naming consistent with `latest.yml`.
  - High/critical dependency audit gate.
  - Full Windows unit/property/behavioral/E2E plus mobile URL/UI test coverage.

## Install

1. Download `Hikasha-Chat-Setup-0.1.5.exe` below.
2. Run it, choose an install location if desired, and finish the installer.
3. Launch Hikasha Chat from the shortcut.
4. Click the gear icon, paste your BotRix chat widget link (must contain
   `?bid=`), press **Enter**, then **Reload** in the settings panel.

The installer is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for
confirmation. Verify the download source is this GitHub release before
continuing.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11
- A free [BotRix](https://botrix.live) account with Twitch, YouTube, and/or
  Kick connected

## Assets

- `Hikasha-Chat-Setup-0.1.5.exe` — Windows installer
- `Hikasha-Chat-Setup-0.1.5.exe.blockmap` — update delta data
- `latest.yml` — auto-update metadata and SHA-512

Full documentation: [README](https://github.com/hikashakatsunori/stream_chat_overlay#readme)
